examples.text: In Europa galt China jahrzehntelang als ein zwar im Inneren hoch problematisches, aber immerhin nach außen friedfertiges Land.
examples.translation: En Europe, la Chine a été considérée pendant des décennies comme un pays certes très problématique à l'intérieur, mais au moins pacifique à l'extérieur.

examples.text: The policeman on the beat moved up the avenue impressively. glosses: Preferring peace by nature; avoiding violence.

examples.text: The long-continued hostilities which had for centuries divided the south and the north divisions of the Island of Britain, had been happily terminated by the succession of the pacific James I, to the English crown.

glosses: Favouring peace rather than conflict; not aggressive, tending to avoid violence (of people, actions etc.).

examples.text: But in the Muslim world we are dealing with regimes who have banished, imprisoned, silenced or neutralised all opposition, even where this is entirely peaceable.
